name: Verify that hovering over the Total button displays the quick cart preview on Desktop
description: As a user, I want to hover over the checkout button to quickly see my items
descriptionHtml: As a user, I want to hover over the checkout button to quickly see my items

testStage.description: As a user, I want to hover over the checkout button to quickly see my items

steps.name: Given I am on the menu page
And I have an empty cart
Check if cart preview is empty
When I click on any coffee cup "Mocha" on the menu to add it to the cart
Then I verify the appearance of the checkout button "Total: $8.00"
Getting total price from the checkout button
When I move the mouse cursor over the "Total" button without clicking
Hover over Total button to show cart preview
Hover over element: [[[[ChromeDriver: chrome on linux (aec8d34ea74bb768664e59926b672572)] -> css selector: .pay-container]] -> css selector: button.pay[data-test='checkout']]

parameters.name: element
parameters.value: [[[[ChromeDriver: chrome on linux (aec8d34ea74bb768664e59926b672572)] -> css selector: .pay-container]] -> css selector: button.pay[data-test='checkout']]

steps.name: Then I verify the appearance and contents of the quick cart preview showing added item
Check if cart preview is visible
When I move the mouse cursor away from the "Total" button and the popup area
Then I verify the quick cart preview popup disappears from the screen
Check if cart preview is visible
